people.name: Gerardo Machado y Morales
people.nameZh: 傑拉爾多·馬查多·莫拉萊斯

heading.zh-Hant: 軍人、糖廠主與自由黨領袖
heading.en: Soldier, sugar-mill owner and Liberal Party leader

body.zh-Hant: 杜克大學出版社的古巴第一共和國論文集稱馬查多為准將，與兄弟卡洛斯共同擁有卡爾米塔（Carmita）糖廠。同書把他描述為自由黨（Partido Liberal）領袖，並於1925年當選共和國總統；以「水、道路與學校」為口號的競選活動，正是他的總統競選。
body.en: A Duke University Press volume on Cuba's First Republic calls Machado a brigadier general who owned the Carmita sugar mill together with his brother Carlos. It describes him as leader of the Partido Liberal and as elected president of the republic in 1925, and notes that the slogan "Water, roads, and schools" anchored his presidential campaign.

citations.quote: Brigadier General Gerardo Machado
owner of the Carmita sugar mill together with his brother Carlos

citations.locator: 第九章（扶輪社）人物列舉
citations.quote: leader of the Partido Liberal, elected as president of the republic in 1925
the presidential campaign of Gerardo Machado
“Water, roads, and schools”

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記他為1925至1933年的古巴總統；美國國會圖書館的國家簡介同樣標示「1925–33」。論文集稱他是中央公路（Carretera Central）與國家議會大廈（Capitolio Nacional）等紀念性建築的推動者。1928年初，在第六屆美洲國家國際會議與美國總統柯立芝訪問之際，他高調落成梅恩號廣場（Plaza del Maine）；該書另指他與公共工程部長塞斯佩德斯是華倫兄弟公司（Warren Brothers）的股東。
body.en: The German National Library authority record lists him as Cuban president 1925–1933, and the Library of Congress country profile likewise gives "1925–33". The volume calls him the promoter of the Carretera Central and of the Capitolio Nacional among other monumental buildings. In early 1928, around the sixth International Conference of American States in Havana and President Calvin Coolidge's visit, he ostentatiously inaugurated the Plaza del Maine; the book also says that he and his minister of public works, Céspedes, were shareholders in Warren Brothers.

citations.quote: 1925-1933 Präsident; Kubanischer Präsident
the cruel dictatorship of Gerardo Machado y Morales (president, 1925–33)

citations.locator: 第七章（歷史城市與紀念建築）
citations.quote: Machado (1925–33), the promoter of the Carretera Central
Capitólio Nacional, among other monumental buildings

Plaza del Maine

body.zh-Hant: 論文集指出，馬查多離開早期的改革主義後，開始行使獨裁權力。美國國會圖書館的國家簡介稱他的統治為「殘酷的獨裁」，並說在數次小規模軍隊叛變之後，他於1933年8月12日被迫辭職並逃離古巴。論文集談到醫界的反對運動時另指，其在推翻獨裁者一事上的作用於1933至1934年達到高潮。
body.en: The volume says that when Machado moved away from his early reformism he assumed dictatorial powers. The Library of Congress profile calls his rule a cruel dictatorship and says that after several small army revolts he was forced to resign and flee the country on 12 August 1933. Discussing the physicians' opposition, the volume adds that their role in the dictator's overthrow culminated in 1933–34.

people.name: Victorino Márquez Bustillos
people.nameZh: 維多里諾·馬奎斯·布斯蒂略斯

body.zh-Hant: 馬克斯·布斯蒂略斯是律師與政治人物，辭典記他生於瓜納雷（Guanare），1858年。他在1877至1887年主持報紙《特魯希略人》（El Trujillano），1890年當選大州「安地斯」的議員；1892年任該聯邦實體的臨時主席，1893年獲克雷斯波晉升為准將。其後他於1902至1904年任特魯希略州政務秘書，1904至1906年任該州議會議員，1909年任蘇利亞州政務秘書。
body.en: The dictionary calls him a lawyer and politician and gives his birthplace as Guanare, 1858. He directed the newspaper El Trujillano from 1877 to 1887 and was a deputy for the great state of Los Andes in 1890; in 1892 he was provisional president of that federal entity and in 1893 Joaquín Crespo promoted him to brigadier general. He was government secretary of Trujillo state in 1902–1904, deputy in the state assembly in 1904–1906, and government secretary of Zulia state in 1909.

Abogado y político.
Director del periódico El Trujillano (1877-1887)
diputado por el gran estado los Andes (1890)
presidente provisional de esa entidad federal en 1892
Ascendido a general de brigada por Joaquín Crespo (1893)

secretario de Gobierno del estado Zulia (1909)

heading.zh-Hant: 參議員、部長與臨時總統

body.zh-Hant: 1910年他任特魯希略州臨時主席，並於1910至1914年任該州參議員；1911至1912年任聯邦區（Distrito Federal）省長，1913至1914年任陸海軍部長。1914年4月，國會選出戈麥斯為共和國總統，但戈麥斯決定不就任，仍留在馬拉凱擔任軍隊總司令；已被任命為臨時總統的馬克斯·布斯蒂略斯，則藉通過臨時憲法規約而留任。
body.en: In 1910 he was provisional president of Trujillo state and from 1910 to 1914 senator for Trujillo; he was governor of the Federal District in 1911–1912 and Minister of War and Navy in 1913–1914. In April 1914 Congress elected Juan Vicente Gómez president, but Gómez decided not to take office and stayed in Maracay as army commander-in-chief; Márquez Bustillos, who had been named provisional president, was kept in office through approval of a provisional constitutional statute.

Senador por el estado Trujillo (1910-1914)
gobernador del Distrito Federal (1911-1912)
es ministro de Guerra y Marina (1913-1914)
En abril de 1914, Juan Vicente Gómez es elegido por el Congreso

había sido nombrado presidente provisional de la República

body.zh-Hant: 辭典稱當時委內瑞拉有兩位總統：臨時總統馬克斯·布斯蒂略斯與當選總統戈麥斯；他向戈麥斯詳報行政細節，並把決定交由這位首領批准。另一條目稱他七年間擔任實質上的「首相」，每週在加拉加斯召集並主持內閣會議。1920年6月30日他批准公布碳氫化合物法，同年國會咨文中他宣布依戈麥斯指示頒令設立軍事航空學校。1921年底戈麥斯患病期間的陰謀導致其垮台；1922年6月國會通過第三次修憲。
body.en: The dictionary says Venezuela effectively had two presidents, the provisional president Márquez Bustillos and the president-elect Gómez; he reported every administrative detail to Gómez and deferred decisions to his approval. Another entry says that for seven years he served as the true "prime minister", convening and chairing weekly cabinet meetings in Caracas. On 30 June 1920 he signed the Hydrocarbons Law, and in his 1920 message to Congress he announced a decree, issued on Gómez's instruction, creating the Military Aviation School. Intrigues during Gómez's illness at the end of 1921 brought about his fall; in June 1922 Congress passed a third constitutional reform.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年他被提名為駐教廷的外交代表，卻因個人問題未能遞交國書。1935年他任總統洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯的首席秘書，數月後在反戈麥斯風潮下被迫辭職。他著有研究解放革命的《兩場戰役》（Dos campañas），並於1918年成為政治科學院院士；辭典記他卒於加拉加斯，日期為1941年1月10日。
body.en: In 1924 he was proposed as diplomatic representative to the Holy See, but personal problems kept him from presenting credentials. In 1935 he was first secretary to President Eleazar López Contreras, and the anti-Gómez reaction forced him to resign within a few months. He wrote Dos campañas, a study of the Liberating Revolution, and became a member of the Academy of Political Sciences in 1918; the dictionary gives his death in Caracas on 10 January 1941.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔稱艾哈邁德沙為卡扎爾王朝第七位也是最後一位統治者，生卒為1897至1930年，在位期間自1909年7月16日至1925年10月31日。義大利百科列其在位為1909至1925年，其父穆罕默德·阿里沙在位為1906至1909年。1909年7月，立憲派軍隊進入德黑蘭，推翻穆罕默德·阿里沙；其十一歲的兒子艾哈邁德被擁立，在攝政之下統治，並受重組後的第二屆議會（Majles）監督。
body.en: The German National Library authority record calls Ahmad Shah the seventh and last ruler of the Qajars, dates him 1897–1930, and gives his reign as 16 July 1909 to 31 October 1925. The Italian encyclopedia lists his reign as 1909–1925 and that of his father Muhammad Ali Shah as 1906–1909. In July 1909 two pro-constitutional armies converged on Tehran and deposed Mohammad Ali Shah; his eleven-year-old son was crowned and ruled under a regent and under the watchful eye of the reconstituted Second Majles.

heading.zh-Hant: 傀儡君主與禮薩汗崛起
heading.en: A figurehead monarch and the rise of Reza Khan

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱艾哈邁德沙名下的中央政府是「傀儡」，在第一次世界大戰期間眼睜睜看著俄英軍隊與土耳其軍在伊朗交戰。1921年2月的政變使哥薩克旅指揮官禮薩汗掌權；至1923年10月，他已出任首相。其後艾哈邁德沙赴歐洲作無限期旅行，實際上再未返回伊朗；義大利百科亦記其自1923年起已在歐洲。
body.en: The entry describes the central government under the figurehead Ahmad Shah as looking on helplessly during the First World War while Russian and British troops fought Turkish forces in Iran. A coup in February 1921 brought to power Reza Khan, commander of the Cossack Brigade, and by October 1923 he had become prime minister. Ahmad Shah then left Iran for Europe on a trip of indefinite duration and in fact never returned; the Italian encyclopedia likewise says he had been in Europe since 1923.

heading.en: Deposition and the end of the dynasty

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱禮薩汗憑軍隊與第五屆議會多數黨的支持，促成1925年10月31日廢黜艾哈邁德沙；兩個月後議會把王權授予禮薩汗，這次「合法」的王權轉移正式結束卡扎爾王朝的統治。義大利百科的卡扎爾條目同樣記載，議會於1925年10月31日表決廢黜該王朝；德國國家圖書館權威檔則記他的在位至同日止。
body.en: The entry says Reza Khan used his power base in the army and among the majority parties in the Fifth Majles to bring about the deposition of Ahmad Shah on 31 October 1925; two months later the Majles vested the monarchy in Reza Khan, and this "legal" transfer formally ended Qajar rule. The Italian encyclopedia's Qajar entry likewise records that parliament voted the dynasty's deposition on 31 October 1925, and the German National Library record ends his reign on the same day.
